description: Runs a Bluetooth DTM transmitter test over the top toolbar Target DUT Control Port connection, with optional Companion Receiver to measure received packets and PER.
help_text:
📡 [Bluetooth DTM TX Test]

1. Setup: Configure the Target DUT Control Port in the top Hardware Connection toolbar (DTM standard baudrate: 19200 bps)
2. Test Runtime: Minimum duration setting is 3000 ms (3 seconds)
3. Companion Receiver (Optional):
   - Set a second DTM device port to receive transmitted packets and evaluate PER
   - Sequence: DUT Transmitter starts first; Companion Receiver starts 1.0s later and stops 1.0s before TX ends
   - Decodable packet patterns (0=PRBS9, 1=1111-0000, 2=1010) are required for packet reception (Pattern 3 is continuous carrier)
4. TX Only: Leave Companion RX Port empty to perform pure transmission without receiver evaluation
name: Bluetooth DTM TX Test
